texts: Dataset metadata were accessed on 10 October 2026, and the selected EEG recordings and
accompanying metadata were retrieved on 11 October 2026. This secondary analysis used the
released coded participant identifiers; no participants were contacted and no re-identification was
attempted. The author had no access to information that could identify individual participants
during or after data collection. Original collection approval and consent and the regulatory basis
for this secondary analysis are documented separately in S2 Text.
